apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Adds dedicated GameSir G8+ MFi motor output through its ExternalAccessory protocol com.xiaoji.M2boot. This model bypasses Core Haptics, which physical testing showed vibrated only the iPhone even for left/right handle tests with phone fallback off. Game rumble and direct left/right motor tests now use accessory packets. Live 0–100% strength remains available, with 100% = 48× gain and Off = zero. Output is capped; stop commands are sent on Off, stream end, disconnect and backgrounding. No implicit Core Haptics fallback for this model. Physical validation of the new transport is pending. Device Release build and 337 tests pass. Unsigned IPA for installer signing.
